organization.evidence: The Azerbaijan Railways Closed Joint Stock Company (ADY) ("the Purchaser") invites sealed bids

pub_date.evidence: Date: 13 October 2026 (Invitation for Bids, PDF dated 13 Oct 2026)

stage.evidence: Open Competitive Bidding – International Advertisement; Single Stage: Two Envelope. No contractor selected.

amount.evidence: Contract value not stated. Only bidder qualification thresholds (turnover US$ 1,600,000; contracts US$ 750,000) and a bidding document fee of US$100/AZN 170.

funding.evidence: Loan 4497-AZE: Azerbaijan Railways Digital Transformation Project; financing from the Asian Development Bank

deadline.evidence: Deadline for Submission of Bids: 22 October 2026, 15:00 hours (Baku local time); not expired as of 2026-10-19 (3 days left)

contact.evidence: c/o Mr. Arif Agayev, Deputy Chairman; PIU Procurement Team, 230 Dilara Aliyeva str., Floor 1, room 163, Baku AZ1010; Telephone: +994 12 499 43 56, +994 12 499 33 84; E-mail: u.binnatova@ady.az and nu.salahov@ady.az

it_landscape.evidence: SAP SuccessFactors EC / P&G / CDP + Succession Management / LMS. The mention of the parallel SAP ERP program is not in this notice; it comes from node/1173231.

quote.evidence: The notice header table reads 'Deadline for Submission of Bids: | 22 October 2026, 15:00 hours (Baku local time)'. The wording is verbatim from the table cells; point 7 repeats 'on or before the deadline: 22 October 2026, 15:00 hours (Baku local time)'.

notes: Check_also. (1) Deadline 22 Oct 2026 15:00 Baku time confirmed in node/1184016. (2) The same IT-09 notice exists in three versions: node/1172326 (dated 21 Aug 2026, deadline 2 Oct), node/1181981 (dated 3 Oct, deadline 15 Oct), node/1184016 (dated 13 Oct, deadline 22 Oct). The deadline has already been extended twice, so another extension is possible. WebSearch found no amendment, corrigendum, or cancellation after 13 Oct, but the ADB procurement listing for Loan 4497-AZE could not be checked directly, so absence of a later version is not proven. Re-check before calling. (3) Contacts: Mr. Arif Agayev, Deputy Chairman is named only as the bid delivery address (c/o), not as an information contact. The information contact is the 'PIU Procurement Team'. The names Binnatova and Salahov appear only inside the e-mail addresses; no names or titles are given for them. The notice also does not say whether Agayev is a decision maker. (4) Scope: SaaS subscriptions for 36 months (Employee Central 1,800; Performance & Goals, Career Development Planning, LMS 1,650 each) plus professional services (design, configuration, integration, data migration, testing, training, deployment, knowledge transfer, post-Go-Live support). Completion: EC and P&G 6 months, CDP + Succession Management 12 months, LMS 18 months. Delivery onsite at the ADY head office in Baku. This is mostly a software subscription plus implementation, not a pure consulting service. (5) Contract amount is not stated. (6) Bidder qualification: average annual turnover of at least US$1.6M, 2 similar contracts totaling US$750k in the last 2 years, bid security, Domestic Preference not applied. Bids are opened soon after the deadline, with a 75:25 technical to financial weighting. The window to prepare a bid is very short, and the bidding documents must first be purchased by written application.

organization.evidence: Executing and implementing agency: Joint Stock Company National Electric Grid of Uzbekistan (NEGU)

pub_date.evidence: ADB news release 'ADB, Uzbekistan Sign $200 Million Power Modernization Loan' dated 15 October 2026

event_date.evidence: Loan agreement signing 15 October 2026 (news release; the project page also lists 'Loan agreement signing: 15 October 2026'; Kun.uz: signed 15 Oct in Bangkok by Masato Kanda and Jamshid Kuchkarov)

stage.evidence: Project page: Status Proposed; Tenders, Contracts Awarded, Procurement Plan unavailable. Approval date shows '-' although the loan agreement was signed.

amount.evidence: Project page: ADB loan US$200.00 million (OCR); program cost $371 million results-based lending, co-financed by the World Bank under the Full Mutual Reliance Framework. News release: 200 million loan; the release does not state the $371M total.

funding.evidence: ADB lead lender, World Bank cofinancing; TA US$650,000 from the Technical Assistance Special Fund (project page)

contact.evidence: Project page: Alfredo Bano, Project Officer, SD1-ENE. News release: Narghiza K. Alikulova, Communications Officer, Uzbekistan Resident Mission, +998 78 120 1230.

it_landscape.evidence: Project page: 'it will modernize, augment, and digitalize priority 35110 kV distribution substations', 'through substation renovation and digital systems, including automated process control, automated power accounting, and digital metering'; governance output includes 'power system digitalization, and cybersecurity measures'

quote.correct: First, it will modernize, augment, and digitalize priority 35110 kV distribution substations
quote.evidence: The phrase 'modernizing and digitalizing priority 35-110 kV distribution substations, and strengthening the governance and institutional capacity of the executing agency' appears neither on the project page nor in the news release (searched with the loan signing page and the Daryo summary). The project page says: 'Second, the program will strengthen NEGU's governance and institutional capacity through improved corporate governance, board oversight, risk management...'. The quote is a paraphrase and must be replaced with a verbatim one. Kun.uz returned 403 and could not be checked for this phrase.

source_tier.evidence: adb.org project page and news release (Tier 1)

notes: Check_also. (1) Loan signing of $200 million on 15 Oct 2026 confirmed by the ADB news release and Kun.uz/Daryo (16 Oct). (2) The digital wording is confirmed on the project page only, not in the news release. The news release says only that the program will 'upgrade 60 critical electricity distribution substations across Uzbekistan and introduce digital systems'. The terms automated, cybersecurity, metering, 371, technical assistance and 650,000 do not appear in the news release. Note that the project page has the typo '35110 kV' for 35-110 kV. (3) TA 650,000 USD from the TASF is confirmed on the project page: 'The attached TA will support monitoring and reporting, DLI measurement and verification, fiduciary capacity, safeguards implementation, digitalization, and verification protocols.' It is for monitoring, DLI verification, fiduciary capacity, safeguards and digitalization, not for a consulting assignment for a vendor. (4) The name Alfredo Bano is confirmed. (5) Future date: the news release says 'World Bank management is expected to seek Board approval later this month for an additional $100 million'; Daryo says 'later in October'. No specific day in either. The release was published 15 Oct, so 'later this month' means by 31 Oct 2026. (6) Project page expected opportunities: electrical equipment supply, civil works and installation for 35-110 kV substations, and consulting that may include a program implementation consultant, specialized firms and individual consultants. Procurement will use country systems, so the tenders may not appear on adb.org. It is results-based lending, so the money goes through the NEGU and the buyer and IT scope are not fixed. No contractor selected.
